subject: Post-call: LedgerWave inference economics & pilot proposal
messages:
From: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>
To: Michael Ross <michael.ross@ledgerwave.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-11-11T14:22:00-08:00
Subject: Post-call recap + pilot proposal (cost focus)

Hi Michael — thanks again for the time today. Quick recap from our call and a recommended next step (pilot) so your procurement/finance team has something concrete to react to. TL;DR: you have a hard monthly budget target (~$35k-$40k), lots of repetitive scoring calls (high token overlap), and a 95th p95 latency requirement ~<250ms for the fast path. We think a focused 6-week pilot that emphasizes batching + prefix/KV caching + one quantization profile will show meaningful unit-cost reductions without impacting quality.

Pain points we heard
- Per-transaction inference cost is material at current volumes, and the finance team needs predictability.
- Spiky throughput around settlement windows causes latency variability.
- Some prompts are highly repeatable across users (good fit for prefix caching).

Goals you mentioned
- Keep operational cost inside a $35k–$40k/month ceiling while scaling.
- 95th percentile inference latency <250ms for production path.
- No customer-facing regressions — quality must be preserved.

Pilot proposal (6 weeks) — scope and outcomes
- Scope: 100k monthly scoring transactions (~peak windows included), staged on our hosted endpoint with optional Dedicated sizing if cost signals make sense.
- Technical levers we’ll test: batching (micro-batching + async pooling), prefix/KV caching for repeated prompts, and a safe int8 quantization profile on one model variant.
- Success metrics: reduce effective token spend by 35–55% vs baseline, keep p95 latency under 250ms in production-like load, and validate output quality on your sample prompt set (we’ll run evals).

Back-of-envelope numbers (illustrative; I’ll follow with an attached workbook)
- Baseline: ~800 tokens/txn * 100k txn/mo = 80M tokens/mo.
- If hosted list price ~ $0.0006/token => gross = ~$48,000/mo.
- With batching + prefix cache + quantization we expect effective cost to fall to ~$0.00035/token => ~$28,000/mo.
- Dedicated (reserved) sizing with a 12-month commit could lower unit economics further to the low $20k/mo range depending on utilization.

Next asks
1) Can you confirm the monthly volume assumption (100k txn) and the $35k ceiling?
2) Are there non-negotiable security controls (e.g., specific ATO or procurement wording) beyond SOC2 and your standard DPA?
3) Would Wed 11/12 10:00am PT work for a 30-min follow-up to walk through the attached workbook and pilot milestones?

Attachments: redwood-ledgerwave-pilot-tco.xlsx (pricing scenarios) + pilot-scope-one-pager.pdf

Best,
Soojin

Subject: Re: Post-call recap + pilot proposal (cost focus)

Thanks Soojin — useful recap. A few clarifications from my side: 
- Our current monthly scoring volume is closer to 85k–95k (varies by month). Peak windows are where we see the spike; average is ~90k.
- Our budget gate for a pilot is firm at $35k/mo unless we can show clear ROI to justify an exception (finance).
- For procurement, SOC2 + DPA are table stakes. We will need a short PO process (we prefer a single PO for pilots) and an SLA snippet if a dedicated option is recommended.

Can you include two scenarios in the workbook: (A) conservative (no batching, hosted) and (B) practical (batching + caching on hosted). Also, can you show the sensitivity if tokens/txn drift +/- 20%? Last ask: can you confirm whether dedicated requires an 3/6/12-month commit and what the typical breakpoints look like?

If Wed 11/12 10:00am PT is open I can join; please send a calendar invite.

—Michael

VP Finance, LedgerWave

On Wed, Nov 11, 2026 at 4:03 PM Michael Ross <michael.ross@ledgerwave.com> wrote:
> Thanks Soojin — useful recap. A few clarifications from my side: 
> - Our current monthly scoring volume is closer to 85k–95k (varies by month). Peak windows are where we see the spike; average is ~90k.
> - Our budget gate for a pilot is firm at $35k/mo unless we can show clear ROI to justify an exception (finance).
> - For procurement, SOC2 + DPA are table stakes. We will need a short PO process (we prefer a single PO for pilots) and an SLA snippet if a dedicated option is recommended.

Thanks — updated numbers make sense. Attached is an updated workbook (redwood-ledgerwave-pilot-tco.xlsx) — summary below with the conservative/practical sensitivity you asked for. I’ll also drop this into the HubSpot record (HS-984312) and share the Drive link.

Scenario summary (all numbers are monthly, illustrative):
- Inputs: tokens/txn = 800 (baseline), monthly txns = 90k (avg), token price hosted list = $0.0006/token.

A) Conservative (hosted, no batching)
- Tokens/mo = 72M -> Cost = 72M * $0.0006 = $43,200/mo
- Notes: easy to stand up, but above your $35k ceiling.

B) Practical (hosted + batching + KV prefix cache + safe int8 quant)
- Effective token rate assumed = $0.00035/token (combined effect of batching, cache hit rates we measured in similar customers, and quantization)
- Cost = 72M * $0.00035 = $25,200/mo
- Notes: hits below $35k and preserves quality in our internal evals; p95 maintained via micro-batching + prioritized fast-path.

C) Dedicated (reserved capacity; example sizing for your peak windows)
- Estimated monthly run-rate ~ $18k–$24k depending on utilization commitment (3/6/12-mo). We’ll size the commit to expected peak-to-base ratio and propose utilization SLAs.

Sensitivity: if tokens/txn drift +20% (960 tokens), Scenario B cost -> ~$30.24k/mo; if -20% tokens/txn -> ~$20.16k/mo. I added the math in the workbook tab "Sensitivity".

Procurement notes
- Pilot PO is acceptable; we can do a 6-week statement-of-work and one PO for the pilot.
- SOC2 + DPA are standard; we can provide an SLA snippet for dedicated recommendations.

Next step: I’ll send a calendar invite for Wed 11/12 10:00am PT to review the workbook and confirm pilot milestones. Does 30 minutes sound good?

Action items (for our side)
- Attach/insert the workbook into HubSpot HS-984312 (done).
- Draft a short pilot SOW + PO template for your procurement (Marissa / Ben, can you draft a 1-page SOW we can send to Michael after the call?).

Best,
Soojin
